description: This file contains unit tests for the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module, including tests for discovering the serve gateway from tailnet peers, handling unavailable status, resolving executable paths, and environment variable handling for subprocesses.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayDiscoveryTests
classes.description: A structure containing test cases for the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module.

methods.name: discovers serve gateway from tailnet peers
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying that the discovery method correctly identifies a serve gateway from tailnet peers in the status JSON.

methods.name: returns empty when status unavailable
methods.description: Asynchronous test ensuring that the discovery method returns an empty list when status data is unavailable.

methods.name: resolves bare executable from PATH
methods.description: Test confirming that the resolveExecutablePath method correctly finds the executable in the system PATH.

methods.name: rejects missing executable candidate
methods.description: Test asserting that missing or invalid executable paths are correctly not resolved.

methods.name: adds TERM for GUI-launched tailscale subprocesses
methods.description: Test verifying that the environment variables include TERM='dumb' when launching subprocesses in a GUI context.

methods.name: preserves existing TERM when building tailscale subprocess environment
methods.description: Test confirming that an existing TERM environment variable value is preserved when forming the environment for subprocesses.
